components.name: API Gateway
components.purpose: Exposes integration endpoints for Shopify webhooks, POS inventory queries, and SAP interfaces.
components.rationale: Selected for enterprise API gateway capabilities including rate limiting and OAuth protection.
trade_offs: Adds minor latency to API invocations.
components.security_considerations: Enforces HTTPS encryption and OAuth2 access token validation.

components.name: Enterprise Service Bus
components.purpose: Decouples integration flows and manages queue retry mechanisms and dead-lettering.
components.rationale: Provides native enterprise messaging with strict queueing order and DLQ capabilities.
trade_offs: Requires active queue depth monitoring to avoid delayed message processing.
components.security_considerations: Uses Azure Private Link and Entra ID authentication for queue access.

components.name: Integration Microservices Execution
components.purpose: Executes serverless transformation logic for order payloads and ATP inventory calculations.
components.rationale: Offers event-driven serverless compute that automatically scales based on message queue volume.
trade_offs: Cold starts can introduce minor latency spikes unless warm instances are reserved.
components.security_considerations: Runs within private VNet subnets with managed identities.

components.name: SFTP File Storage and Integration
components.cloud_service: SFTP support for Azure Blob Storage
components.purpose: Hosts secure SFTP file storage for 3PL drop files, dispatches, and payment settlement reports.
components.rationale: Provides managed SFTP endpoint capability over Blob Storage directly supporting legacy file integrations.
trade_offs: Incurs higher cost compared to standard Blob Storage standard endpoint access.
components.security_considerations: Restricts access to encrypted SFTP channels with isolated folder permissions.

components.name: Workflow Orchestrator
components.purpose: Orchestrates batch workflows, 3PL schedule drops, and sequence gap checking routines.
components.rationale: Delivers low-code workflow orchestration with built-in connectors for file parsing and APIs.
trade_offs: Complex custom business logic is harder to maintain in visual workflows than standard code.
components.security_considerations: Secures external API triggers with SAS tokens and Entra ID.

components.name: Operational & Reconciliation Database
components.purpose: Stores integration execution history, reconciliation break reports, and audit logs.
components.rationale: Fully managed relational database providing ACID compliance and historical data query capability.
trade_offs: Requires database scaling tier adjustments to handle long-term payload archive query load.
components.security_considerations: Enforces transparent data encryption at rest and Private Endpoint network isolation.

components.name: Web Management Portal
components.purpose: Provides a web portal for operators to inspect failed interfaces and trigger message replays.
components.rationale: Offers fully managed platform hosting for web operational dashboards.
components.security_considerations: Requires authentication via Entra ID with role-based access control.

components.name: Identity Provider
components.purpose: Manages central identity and access control for system applications and operators.
components.rationale: Standard enterprise identity provider providing unified multi-factor authentication.
trade_offs: Requires synchronization setup with existing corporate directories.
components.security_considerations: Implements strict conditional access policies and MFA for portal access.

components.validation_reason: Security secret management mechanism relies on default Azure assumptions.
components.name: Key Management Service
components.purpose: Stores and manages cryptographic keys, connection strings, and integration secrets.
components.rationale: Provides hardware-backed secure key management integrated with Azure services.
trade_offs: API call limits require local caching of secrets in application microservices.
components.security_considerations: Restricts access using managed identities with granular RBAC permissions.

components.name: Observability Dashboard
components.purpose: Visualizes system performance metrics, transaction volumes, and integration failure alerts.
components.rationale: Fully managed Grafana instance fulfilling customer requirements for familiar monitoring dashboards.
trade_offs: Requires manual metric dashboard configuration and query tuning.
components.security_considerations: Restricts dashboard access through Entra ID single sign-on.

components.validation_reason: VNet topology and subnet design based on standard Azure security assumptions.
components.name: Virtual Network
components.purpose: Provides isolated network topology for microservices and database integration traffic.
components.rationale: Establishes secure enterprise network perimeters and private endpoint connectivity.
trade_offs: Increases networking layout and routing rule configuration complexity.
components.security_considerations: Blocks public endpoint exposure using network security groups.

components.validation_reason: Environment deployment pipeline standard setup pending customer verification.
components.name: CI/CD Pipeline & Deployment Automation
components.purpose: Automates multi-environment deployments and infrastructure provision processes.
components.rationale: Provides integrated CI/CD pipelines supporting Bicep infrastructure-as-code scripts.
trade_offs: Requires pipeline template maintenance for environment promotions.
components.security_considerations: Enforces deployment approval gates and secret injection from Key Vault.

components.validation_reason: Recommended runtime container platform to handle peak Black Friday scaling.
components.name: Auto-scaling Container Platform
components.purpose: Hosts scalable microservice containers and manages dynamic auto-scaling for peak loads.
components.rationale: Provides serverless container execution that scales down to zero and up for peak events.
trade_offs: Slightly higher operational complexity than standard serverless functions.
components.security_considerations: Runs containers inside virtual network subnets without public IPs.

components.name: Automated Backup Service
components.purpose: Automates backup and disaster recovery processes for database and file assets.
components.rationale: Provides centralized backup management ensuring compliance with long-term data retention mandates.
trade_offs: Long-term retention storage incurs cumulative backup vault storage costs.
components.security_considerations: Encrypts backup vaults with customer-managed keys.

environments.dev: Isolated Azure environment deployed via Bicep templates for development and initial integration testing.
environments.test: Pre-production test environment simulating peak data loads and integration contract validation.
environments.prod: Highly available production environment deployed across eu-north-1 with full redundancy.

deployment_runtime.text: Deployment and runtime are managed through automated Infrastructure-as-Code pipelines. Serverless workloads and container instances scale dynamically across subnets.

availability_scalability.text: Auto-scaling rules accommodate peak transaction volumes up to 68,000 orders per day during Black Friday. Services use multi-zone availability to ensure continuous operation.

backup_dr.text: Automated daily backups and point-in-time recovery ensure non-disruptive operations and long-term 7-year audit retention compliance.

observability.text: Centralized metrics, queue tracking, and log aggregation stream into Azure Managed Grafana and the web operator portal.

security_controls.text: Data in transit is secured via TLS 1.3 while data at rest is encrypted using Key Vault keys, fulfilling GDPR requirements.
